# OrkasVideoStudio

> An open-source (MIT) video studio for coding agents, and an open-source alternative to Claude Motion and CapCut. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any agent that can run a shell or speak MCP edits your footage, designs motion graphics, adds narration, music and captions, generates missing shots with your own provider keys, and delivers a checked MP4 that you can keep editing in a browser canvas.

It has three parts: a host-neutral SKILL.md pack with `video-studio` as the entry skill; the `ovs` CLI and an MCP server that mirrors it; and an editable production, a plain folder holding the scene timeline (`videos/main/manifest.json`), an asset ledger, sourced product facts and an optional designed page. It requires Node 22 or newer, pnpm, and ffmpeg/ffprobe. Install it from source until the npm packages are published; the skill pack is also listed on skills.sh (`npx skills add orkas-ai/orkas-videostudio`). Editing, designed motion graphics, captions and transcription need no API keys; image, video and speech generation are opt-in and use your own provider accounts. There is no hosted backend and no account to create. OrkasVideoStudio is also the built-in video agent in the Orkas desktop app for macOS and Windows (https://orkas.ai/?source=gh-orkas-vs).

## Docs

- [OrkasVideoStudio README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/main/README.md): What it is, what you can ask for, use cases, install, how a production works, the canvas, providers, commands and how it compares.
- [What you can ask for](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#what-you-can-ask-for): The four capabilities that one timeline can combine: editing real footage, designed motion, sound and captions, and generated shots.
- [Motion graphics in Claude Code, without a Team plan](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#motion-graphics-in-claude-code-without-a-team-plan): Claude Motion is in beta on Claude Team and Enterprise plans only. With OrkasVideoStudio, Claude Code on Pro, Max, Ultra or an API key writes the same kind of code-built motion graphics and renders the MP4 locally.
- [Use cases](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#use-cases): Example requests and what happens for advertising and marketing, film and drama, editing, explainers and tutorials, and recreating popular videos.
- [Install](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#install): Prerequisites, and installing from source or, once published, from npm.
- [Drive it from Claude Code, Codex or any coding agent](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#drive-it-from-claude-code-codex-or-any-coding-agent): Native skills for Claude Code and Codex, MCP tools, or the self-describing CLI.
- [How a production works](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#how-a-production-works): The production folder, the scene timeline, and the prepare, check, snapshot, render and ship steps.
- [Browser video canvas](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#browser-video-canvas): The canvas that opens after import, prepare, render or ship and edits the same files as the CLI and MCP.
- [BYO generation providers](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#byo-generation-providers): Configuring your own speech, image and video providers, and inspecting a configuration without paid calls.
- [What keeps generation bounded](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#what-keeps-generation-bounded): Existing material first, and confirmed provider, model, request count and cost before any paid call.
- [How it compares](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#how-it-compares): OrkasVideoStudio vs Claude Motion vs CapCut, and vs programmatic frameworks (Remotion, Revideo), AI SaaS editors and thin MCP or ffmpeg wrappers.
- [Relationship to Orkas](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/blob/main/README.md#relationship-to-orkas): How OrkasVideoStudio relates to the Orkas desktop app, where it ships as a built-in agent.
- [About OrkasVideoStudio](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/main/ABOUT.md): A short summary of what the project is, who it is for and where it comes from.
- [OrkasVideoStudio — 开源技术方案（Plan v0.1）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas-VideoStudio/main/PLAN.md): The original technical plan: positioning, decision record, target architecture and capability layer.
